description: Answer a hint of list_persons' 'similar' with «these are two different people» — «Mikhailov» and «Mikhaylov» who are not one — so the pair is not hinted again; or, with 'undo', take that answer back. ASK the person first, naming both as list_persons shows them; never decide it yourself from the names. A person merged into another answers as the one they were merged into. merge_persons on such a pair still merges, and the answer goes. Both journals keep a line. Members of the project who may write only. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

a.description: One of the two, as list_persons returned them.

undo.description: true to take the answer back, so the hint may pair them again. Default false.

name: distinct_persons
